dict.string: Persona sets alarms and timers only when you ask and approve it on your iPhone, for example to wake you at 6:40 or to start a 25-minute focus timer.
Persona plays Apple Music when you ask, for example a playlist for focused work, and can pause or skip what the Music app is playing.

Persona lets Claude read and add calendar events when you ask, for example to check whether you are free on Friday afternoon or to book a meeting. It also names a meeting recording after the event happening now.
Persona adds events to your calendar when you ask Claude to, for example to save a meeting it scheduled for you.
Persona uses the camera to scan the pairing QR code printed by `personad hub pair`, and to take a photo you add to a chat or a meeting, for example a whiteboard during a meeting.
Persona lets Claude look up your contacts when you ask, for example to find a colleague's phone number or email before drafting a message.
Persona asks for Face ID before it types a Mac's remembered password on that Mac's lock screen, when you tap One-Tap Unlock on the Mac's page.

Persona lets Claude read health summaries when you ask, for example how many steps you walked this week or how long you slept last night. With rolling recording on, Persona also checks heart rate, HRV, steps, workouts and the moods you log, on your iPhone only, to keep the minutes around them.
Persona saves health data only after you approve it on your iPhone, one entry at a time, for example a weight or last night's sleep you told Claude about.
Persona controls your Home accessories and scenes only when you ask and approve each change on your iPhone, for example to turn off the living room light.
Persona connects straight to your computer when it's on the same Wi-Fi, to show its screen faster.
Persona shares your current location with Claude only when you ask, for example to find what time it is where you are or which office you are in.

Persona records audio when you start a recording or dictate a message, for example a meeting or a spoken note. Recordings are transcribed on your iPhone and only the text is saved to the knowledge base on your hub; the audio stays on your iPhone, except while you hold Talk in a meeting: what is said then goes to the voice service. A meeting you choose to transcribe on the hub sends its audio, Talk included, through your hub to the speech service it is set up with, and the hub deletes it once the meeting's minutes are written. In a voice conversation you start — on the phone or in CarPlay — your voice is streamed through your hub to the realtime speech service it is set up with, only while the conversation is open.
Persona saves images Claude produces to your library when you ask, for example a chart it generated.
Persona shows your recent photos under the + button so you can attach them to a message, and lets Claude look at recent photos when you ask, for example to read a screenshot you took.
Persona lets Claude read and create reminders when you ask, for example to add “review the PR” to your Today list.
Persona turns your voice into text when you hold the mic button, for example to dictate a reply to Claude.
